title: NSE to increase Nifty 50 real-time dissemination frequency from 250 ms to 100 ms
text: NSE to increase Nifty 50 real-time dissemination frequency from 250 ms to 100 ms. Under the revised framework, the Nifty 50 index will be disseminated live at a frequency of 100 milliseconds, or 0.10 second, compared with the current frequency of 250 milliseconds, or 0.25 second.
